The '''DL-III NightFang''' was a model of [[Laser turret/Legends|laser turret]] manufactured by [[Golan Arms/Legends|Golan Arms]]. They were usually installed on [[Space station/Legends|space stations]] such as the [[FireStar-class Orbital Defense Station|''FireStar''-class Orbital Defense Station]].<ref name="HS" />
